chapter: Queens Terrace, Decca records and Amen
title: Band changes and the vocalist Hazel Diaz
summary: Stovall leaves for Red Allen, Godley drinks and returns, Hazel Diaz sings on record.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: By the time you came back was when you would have had these changes in the band. You would have had these changes when Buster Smith came in the band. Stovall must have quit you at that time and gone with Red Allen.
What happened to Godley, was he drinking too?
He started drinking too bad and you got Joe Smith?
didn't stay too long and I got Godley back.
This Hazel Diaz, was she working with you too?
No, she's someone that they knew down at Decca, they all knew her.
This is yours, right, "Case of the Blues?"
"Between You and the Devil" is probably yours too.
